scripts.check: pnpm check:generated && pnpm check:format && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:skills && pnpm check:actions && pnpm check:go && pnpm check:sql && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:shell
scripts.check:format: test -z "$(gofmt -l apps db internal)" && pnpm --filter @enterprise/contracts format:check && pnpm --filter @enterprise/web format:check
scripts.check:generated: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- spec/generated internal/api internal/store apps/web/src/api/generated
scripts.check:go: test -z "$(gofmt -l apps db internal)" && go vet ./...
scripts.db:migrate: GOFLAGS='-tags=no_clickhouse,no_libsql,no_mssql,no_mysql,no_sqlite3,no_vertica,no_ydb' go tool goose -dir db/migrations postgres "${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://enterprise:enterprise@127.0.0.1:5432/enterprise?sslmode=disable}" up
scripts.db:status: GOFLAGS='-tags=no_clickhouse,no_libsql,no_mssql,no_mysql,no_sqlite3,no_vertica,no_ydb' go tool goose -dir db/migrations postgres "${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://enterprise:enterprise@127.0.0.1:5432/enterprise?sslmode=disable}" status
scripts.generate: pnpm generate:contract && pnpm generate:server && pnpm generate:web && pnpm generate:db
scripts.format: pnpm format:go && pnpm --filter @enterprise/contracts format && pnpm --filter @enterprise/web format
